title: What a prune reads in claims/

items.note: the running version: protected whatever its age
2 d old: fresh, so 1.25.0's entries stay
20 d old: goes after the last 1.24.0 entry
stale twin from another install: goes as well

caption: A claim is an empty file whose name is the version and whose mtime is the last use. Only regular files you own count.
